Today's pem is fatigue and malaise radiating from nape and in wrists. Mild but annoying. Interesting how simple over exertion leads to this more muffled pem fatigue while the post sexual worsening is this poisoned sludge in brain building up into a violent crash

phenotypes.definition: A crash presentation in which brain fatigue, sometimes with the patient-described lactate-like brain sensation, can intensify into overwhelming sleep pressure and sometimes involuntary or prolonged sleep. Sleep is common but not obligatory; brain fatigue and lactate-like sensation without a full crash remain separate from this subtype.
phenotypes.onset_scope: Described by patient records before and during 2026; not asserted to begin with the later lactate-like quality.

retrospective_sources.quoted_text: 7- brain fatigue mild crash then sleep pressure
9- crashed from the brain fatigue but didn’t fall asleep

despite having slept 8h the previous day after being wired but managing to stop the activity, and the fatigue and other usual accompanying symptoms were milder the next day, i still ended up having the brain lactate → fatigue → forced sleep of around 5h as usual. so it seems it’s not purely the shorter sleep that i get after wired days that leads to the pem/cns sleep crash, but specifically the flow/wired state. this is an important clue

3.40-5 brain fatigue, burning brain, interestingly didn’t crash into sleep. cannot be certain that this is a result of the clona, as i continue to exert somewhat above baseline but it very likely is. the reaction is also more akin to a sudden flare then the progressive buildup i usually get post exertion. need to trial clona one more time on a good day to control for pem

1 tingling in arms legs begins
2 amplifies to corrosive pain
3 meanwhile overall energy/motivation drops, increasingly sensitive to light and sounds (same screen i was just looking st causes shivers down the spine)
4 not part of the symptom presentation but it is at this point i usually go from propped up on bed to curling up in fetal pose to rest motionless as it's the only bearable "activity" at this stage, eyes closed, sometimes still listening to audiobook though (on very loud volume)
5 if i'm lucky it slowly gets milder. otherwise, the poisoned feeling spreads to spine and brain, brain fatigue increases, and sensory sensitivity rises to extremes - brain pem/pene
6 optional, this really only started happening since rapa: brain burns and strong frontal lobe (helmet) as well as sinus pressures come on roughly at same time as brain pem
7 by now of course cognitive function crawls to a halt, i'm barely able to think, speaking feels impossible, or really, doing anything at this point is extremely hard because my brain is in so much pain and and is so sluggish that it feels like transmitting commands goes at snails pace.
8 during the worst crashes, after the above symptoms get better, i suddenly become very sleepy and usually fall asleep. it almost feels like my body became so exhausted from the above it now needs to go into recovery asap.
The patient added that sudden anger or frustration could briefly enable action despite difficulty initiating movement. Examples included standing to urinate after an hour, briefly raising the voice, and adjusting curtains in response to painful light or noise.

phenotypes.definition: Recurring neurological-exacerbation presentation with possible brain burning, abrupt cognitive slowing, subjective helmet-like head pressure, sometimes tinnitus or irritability. The patient says this remains present, though other PEM presentations are now more prominent.
phenotypes.onset_scope: Predominant PEM/PENE expression before the October 2024 NADH-associated change; patient reports continuing episodes afterward.

retrospective_sources.quoted_text:

* smoldering and painful pressure mainly in frontal lobe in one point → can be very painful
